title: rui1021: sfx1021 + remote UI (Pi with the 1021 kernel only)
description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote UI: hold TRK, press YES for the SIDECAR status page and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font. Needs the Raspberry Pi with the 1021 kernel (an older kernel shows the pages without text). Untested with the Teensy: use sfx1021 there. Tested in the emulator; not yet confirmed on a real Rytm.
